description: Solo-founder product-discovery toolkit: cofounder runs a single-session founding meeting that takes you from nothing to a chosen direction and an actionable plan with a falsifiable first move.

plugins.name: cofounder
plugins.description: A founding meeting between you and Claude as co-founders: establish who you honestly are, get educated on a landscape with live web evidence, converge on a direction with honest co-founder pushback, and leave with an actionable plan and a falsifiable first move. Calibrates to your real experience per domain (beginner to pro); once a direction is validated, earns a minute-detail execution handoff with prompt files for a Claude Code subagent team.

Disciplined, evidence-based knowledge management for reverse-engineering and research projects. Where a file lives tells you how much to trust it: provisional work in active/, facts verified by DIRECT evidence in docs/truth/ (the 'Wall'), finished investigations as chronicles in docs/history/. You work in 'campaigns' (open -> investigate -> delegate to subagents -> review against the Wall -> promote what's proven -> close into a chronicle), with an optional lifecycle for hiring external AI agents as research drafters. /init-project drops the structure into any repo.
plugins.name: re-discipline
